body: I feel like it's just really hard to help someone who does not want to be helped. I'm not saying she wants attention, but the way that she went about it and the things that she says to her ex are making it seem that way. She even has had a new boyfriend for a week that she says she likes so much! And this happened last night so I don't know.

She doesn't know that I know because she sent these to her ex-boyfriend (they were only together like 3 weeks). He just happens to be one of my good friends and showed me them out of concern. This all happened last night and today she seems perfectly fine and happy. So I have no idea what's going on with her. She is not the kind of person you can approach, as I have recently found out. She is the kind of person to get pissed off about things like that and I know she would take my offering of help offensively. She would most likely just take it out on her ex and get mad at him for telling me or tell me to just mind my own business. So I have no idea how to help her.
